purpose: Define the Species/Form-aware Character Appearance Studio Inspector surface over semantic taxonomy v0.2 without hard-coding a humanoid paper doll or transferring biological/equipment authority into appearance state.
global_rules: Controls are derived from authorized morphology/profile choice schemas, never from a universal humanoid slider inventory.
A missing anatomy field is unknown/unavailable, not implicitly human, absent or zero.
Source-owned biology/current Form/history is inspectable but not cosmetically rewritten.
Every visual control has a text label/value and nonvisual summary effect; color is never the only state carrier.
Mobile/touch, keyboard-only, screen-reader and high-zoom operation must expose the same semantic choices.
AI may propose appearance choices but never commits them without the same explicit write authorization as a human action.

inspector_sections.name: randomize_and_locks
inspector_sections.rule: randomization never changes source-owned biology/history/current Form/equipment ownership

Arborae.rule: four linked but separately customizable profiles; do not reduce to one recolor

Mythragara.rule: hybrid derives from authored identities and is not independently freeform

Nekron.rule: appearance cannot trigger ascension or select an unavailable outcome

Suula.rule: persistent markers cannot be erased; hand-in-claw state is live/pose

Furashin.rule: up to three colors plus pattern/texture; filename labels on reference art do not define Species

ManyToms.renderer_behavior: repeat/cohere constituent appearance as one collective entity
ManyToms.rule: do not require exactly seventeen visible sprites

Stygian.rule: wing appearance never grants flight; functional/vestigial status comes from upstream state

Toba-Madra.rule: actual cybernetics are equipment/augmentation projection; cosmetic plating remains presentation

The Free.rule: very broad humanoid android grammar; actual replacement hardware remains mechanics-owned

Vespin.rule: wardrobe/equipment variants must support four-arm anchors or report unsupported

Moravi.rule: never collapse to two-leg humanoid layout

Rakuuta.rule: swept-back structures are ears, not horns

responsive_behavior.desktop: Inspector + preview may coexist; semantic controls remain primary over canvas size.
responsive_behavior.mobile: Preview and Inspector may stack/switch; no control disappears; touch targets and text summaries remain equivalent.
responsive_behavior.keyboard: All category, value, view, preset, randomize and commit actions reachable without pointer input.
responsive_behavior.screen_reader: Every preview has structured nonvisual summary and deterministic changed-field announcements.
responsive_behavior.high_zoom: No clipped mandatory controls; preview may reduce before semantic control loss.
responsive_behavior.reduced_motion: No appearance state requires animation to understand; transitions use textual/state alternatives.
